import ctypes
import os

# Define the result structure
class gsl_sf_result(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_sf_transport_2_e(const double x, gsl_sf_result * result)
gsl.gsl_sf_transport_2_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_sf_result)]
gsl.gsl_sf_transport_2_e.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Python function to call the C function
def transport_2(x):
    result = gsl_sf_result()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_transport_2_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError('Error in gsl_sf_transport_2_e')
    return result.val
